name: Is large-format tile a good idea for a bathroom shower, or will it cause problems?

mainEntity.name: Is large-format tile a good idea for a bathroom shower, or will it cause problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile size affects appearance, cuts, slope, grout maintenance, and installation complexity, so the best choice depends on where the tile is used and how the room drains. Large-format tile can reduce grout lines but may require flatter substrates and careful handling; smaller tile can make shower slopes and curved areas easier while increasing grout maintenance. Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate customized tile work with the room’s layout and waterproofing system. Key factors include: - Shower floor slope and drain position - Wall flatness - Slip resistance - Grout color and cleaning tolerance. Review full-size samples and a tile layout before ordering. Confirm how corners, niches, transitions, and damaged replacement pieces will be handled.
acceptedAnswer.description: Large-format tile can create a clean look with fewer grout lines, but it requires suitable substrate flatness, careful installation, and a shower floor layout that handles slope. Smaller tile may work better on complex floors or curved areas.
